heading: The Brow Healing Rollercoaster
intro: The client specifically requested this aftercare feature, so it is included as a main website section.

stages.text: OMG! I’m in love with my new brows. Thank you!
I don’t like this colour, it’s too dark.
Oh no! My brows are scabbing and falling off.
Thank God my brows are coming back! Still looking patchy and uneven.
After touch up: Aww, they’re beautiful! I love them! Thanks again!

posterAlt: Illustrated six-stage eyebrow aftercare journey featuring the Effortless Beauty mermaid, from fresh treatment through healing, flaking, patchiness, colour returning and the healed result.
posterCaption: Concept preview — final artwork and wording can be refined before publication.
